mapper.insert: INSERT INTO messages ( session_id, turn_id, ordinal, role, content, thinking, tool_calls, details, status, delivery_status, run_id, assistant_seq_in_turn, tokens_in, tokens_out ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{turnId}, #{ordinal}, #{role}, #{content}, #{thinking}, #{toolCalls}, #{details}, #{status}, #{deliveryStatus}, #{runId}, #{assistantSeqInTurn}, #{tokensIn}, #{tokensOut} ) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE role = new.role, content = new.content, thinking = new.thinking, tool_calls = new.tool_calls, details = new.details, status = new.status, delivery_status = new.delivery_status, run_id = new.run_id, assistant_seq_in_turn = new.assistant_seq_in_turn, tokens_in = new.tokens_in, tokens_out = new.tokens_out
